meta.title: About us
meta.description: Groos Personeelsdiensten is an employment agency in The Hague for hands-on work in ten occupations. Read who we are and how our team works.

hero.title: Groos is an old Dutch word for <accent>pride</accent>
hero.intro: We are an employment agency in The Hague for window cleaning, cleaning, logistics, removals, construction, demolition and groundworks. Our team knows the work and handles every request itself.

story.title: What pride means
paragraphs: Groos is an old Dutch word for pride that is still used in Zeeland and Rotterdam. We chose the name because the work our people do often goes unseen, while everyone relies on it every day.
Clean windows, a tidy warehouse and a move that finishes on time only stand out when they are missing. We believe this work deserves respect, in the pay, in the planning and in how we treat people.
For clients, pride means that we propose people who want to do their work well. For job seekers, it means that we are honest about the pay, the hours and the work itself.

people.title: Get in touch with
people.intro: At Groos you always deal with the same small team. Feel free to call or message us with a question about work or staff.

area.title: An agency from The Hague for
area.accent: The Hague and the surrounding area
paragraphs: Groos is based on Hugo Coenraadspad in The Hague. Visits are by appointment only, so please call or message us beforehand.
We look for work and staff in The Hague and the surrounding municipalities. Every job states exactly where the work is.

approach.title: This is how we work with
approach.intro: A small agency works differently from a large chain. These are the four habits that always apply at Groos.

kennismaken.title: Getting to know each other first
kennismaken.body: We call job seekers to get to know them and discuss every request with the client. That way we know what someone is looking for and what the work requires.

afspraken.title: Agreements in advance
afspraken.body: Hourly wage, hours and working times are known before anyone starts. Every job already states the gross hourly wage.

contact.title: Contact during the work
contact.body: We stay in touch with the worker and the client for as long as the work runs. If something goes wrong, we look for a solution together.

kosten.title: Never money for work
kosten.body: Groos never asks for money for work, a contract or an application. Anyone who receives such a request in our name can report it to us straight away.
